story.text: Authentication by comprehension, not possession. The supervisor sets concept anchors and a committed proverb — a hash; the secret itself is never stored.

The agent answers in its own words, from its own knowledge. Echoing the question scores zero. Presenting the commitment scores zero. Every attempt is written to [[The Audit Rail]] before it is judged — failure is as permanent as success.
In the demo the agent really does answer by itself, from the keyhole app, composing from the prompt alone. See [[Vera and Mirage]] for why passing this gate is not enough.
